title: A global variational calculus on Fréchet manifolds and the Lagrangian structure of the Einstein evolution equations
summary: We develop a variational calculus for curves on Fréchet manifolds and apply it to the Lagrangian formulation of the Einstein evolution equations on the manifold $\Mm$ of Riemannian metrics of a compact manifold. For mechanical Lagrangians associated with weak pseudo-Riemannian metrics, we establish the Euler--Lagrange equations, energy conservation, and an infinitesimal Noether theorem that does not require the symmetry vector field to generate a flow.
